translations.web: In you have they uncovered their fathers’ nakedness. In you have they humbled her who was unclean in her impurity.
translations.bsb: In you they have uncovered the nakedness of their fathers; in you they violate women during their menstrual impurity.
translations.kjv: In thee have they discovered their fathers' nakedness: in thee have they humbled her that was set apart for pollution.
